candidate_reports.remark: Mountain View Road from East Crystal Drive to East Desert Greens Drive closed due to flash flooding.
Several streets are flooded out across the city of Joshua Tree south of Highway 62.
Strong gradient winds resulted in a wind gust of 63 mph at Lake Havasu City Airport. KHII.
Debris and flowing water over the roadway. Hard closure of Amboy Road at Amboy and Godwin and Amboy and Chadwhich.
Vehicle stuck in flash flood waters at Amboy Road and Bauman Drive.
Gusts in excess of 58 mph started at 0430 and continued through 0540. Peak gust was 65 mph at 0440 and 0520 measured at Holy Moses Wash. AZT23.
Mid Hills RAWS measured a gust of 61 mph due to gradient winds. MDHC1.
Truxton Canyon RAWS measured a gust of 73 mph from nearby thunderstorms. TCRA3.
Downed power line in Barstow Heights due to nearby thunderstorms.
